Generation 0 prototype pouch cells achieved 500 cycles at 82% capacity retention; Generation 1 cells showed only 3% capacity loss in the first 100 cycles. As of January 2025 the company planned independent cell validation and a transition to prismatic cell production by end-2025. A recycling facility capable of processing 20,000 t/year of LFP batteries is scheduled to begin construction mid-2026.

Current stage is R&D with no announced production capacity.

ITEN's Dardilly pilot line produces more than 30 million batteries per year, with a high-volume manufacturing facility planned by 2028.

Salzgitter serves as the lead plant and technology reference for PowerCo's subsequent gigafactories in Sagunto (Spain) and St. Thomas (Canada).

research.summary: theion (Berlin, founded 2020) develops lithium-sulfur crystal batteries using its proprietary Direct Crystal Imprinting (DCi) process, which grows a crystalline sulfur cathode directly from molten sulfur without solvents. The cell architecture uses a solid-state polymer electrolyte and a lithium metal anode, targeting energy densities of ≥1,000 Wh/kg primarily for eVTOL and aerospace markets. The company opened a Technology Centre at Berlin-Adlershof with 1 MWh/year of semi-automatic cell assembly capacity for customer samples, and claims third-party validated 2,000-cycle performance for its lithium metal anode chemistry.

Qkera is currently in talks with major European OEMs and battery manufacturers, and holds a growing patent family.

A new supply contract requires P6 6th-generation prismatic NCA cells for Hyundai-Kia European EVs, starting from 2026. The conversion process involves both upgrading existing factory 1 and scaling factory 2.
